title: Signature recovery without signer checks (solidity) — review required
description: A solidity contract recovers a signer with ecrecover. Malformed input returns the zero address, and a malleable signature can verify under a second encoding. This lexical rule flags the recovery; the reviewer confirms the result is checked against the expected signer and a nonce.
remediation: Check the recovered signer against the expected address, add a zero-address check and a nonce, and reject high-s signatures.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: every ecrecover call matches, including checked calls.

tests.line: address signer = ecrecover(hash, v, r, s);
# audit: address signer = ecrecover(hash, v, r, s); present
